error_decomposition.denominator: target-partner associations, not deduplicated undirected edges

protocol.selection_data: Development cutoffs 2000–2008 only; no validation or test results observed before this freeze.
protocol.selection_reason: Recent fractional PPR exceeded CN at all eight development anchors; AA is the strongest equal-year DBLP mean among the prespecified CN/AA/RA baselines. All three ML ablations remain secondary comparisons.
protocol.pool: all historically observed candidates except focal and prior partners
protocol.primary_reporting: Show each domain/year and equal-year final-test recall differences separately per domain; no edge-level pooled independence or picking favorable years.
protocol.no_retuning: Run all validation and final-test years under this immutable selection. Validation is diagnostic, not an opportunity to change this protocol. Any later method requires a new explicitly exploratory evaluation; do not reuse this final test for model selection.
protocol.activation: A holdout score does not validate mentor identity, degree, promotion or OpenAlex-domain personal probabilities. No automatic identity or production prediction gate is opened.

holdout.interpretation: Immutable chronological holdout; no post-holdout parameter selection. Paired intervals are conditional on each fixed source graph and historical-activity cohort. Not new-person generalization, causal career effects or mentor identification.

holdout_aggregate.scope: Conditional on the fixed three final years, source graphs and sampled historical-activity populations. Years are not resampled; these are not intervals for future-year generalization. History was seen during development, not an untouched domain.
holdout_aggregate.analysis: Predeclared equal-year mean contrast, with reporting-only bootstrap and repeated-author cluster sensitivity; no model or query changes.

frozen_snapshot_manifest.note: Immutable original scientific implementation. Later production fixes must not alter this snapshot.

holdout_costs.scope: Event counts are measured from the frozen query traces. Pages are a proxy assuming 100 events per page, complete sequential responses, and no reuse across focal targets; not measured OpenAlex billing, HTTP requests or latency. The focal author query is included in event/page volume but excluded from the extra-author budget.
